principles: HFF institutional and hosting milestones are chronology context, not direct annual quality measurements.
FIFA Big Count 2006 evidence is gated from 2006 and used mainly for participation/access context.
FIFA Professional Football Report 2023 evidence is gated from 2023 and does not backcast the modern professional ecosystem.
Major-event hosting supports organisational/elite context but trophies and rankings are not calibration targets.
9+ remains reserved for world-leading dimensions and is not reached by this Greece evidence set.
